text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, nafcillin sodium inventory across the three Corvale sites ranges from 16 to 23 days on hand at present usage rates. The 2 g/8 mL vial at Corvale East holds only 3.5 days of supply. The Eugia US LLC product (NDC 55150012316) lists Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312) as a registered plant for analysis and manufacture. A separate Heritage/Avet product (NDC 23155090641) names Antibiotice SA as the manufacturing plant, but that plant is not placed in FDA registration data.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1286862 of Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312) ended on 2025-09-05 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2025-12-04. The same Eugia product also names Apitoria Pharma Private Limited (FEI 3004051616) for analysis and API manufacture, and EUGIA SEZ PRIVATE LIMITED (FEI 3011905047) for analysis, manufacture, and pack, both with VAI inspection histories. Naflcillin sodium is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list as of today.

Our position: Supply is constrained, particularly the 2 g vial at Corvale East. The OAI classification at Aurobindo Pharma Limited is a known regulatory finding. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. Alternative manufacturers have available stock but their labeled plants cannot be verified in FDA registration data.

Recommended actions:
1. Place purchase orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., Avenacy Inc., Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, and NorthStar Rx, LLC to replenish all vial sizes — buyer approves.
2. Request plant registration verification from each alternative supplier before first shipment — buyer and quality assurance approve.
3. Allocate incoming stock first to Corvale East 2 g vial and then to other sites by days on hand — buyer and pharmacy operations manager approve.
4. Report weekly inventory positions to the committee until all sites exceed 30 days on hand — buyer approves.

Not recommended: Delay purchasing while awaiting FDA shortage listing; rely solely on the Eugia product given the OAI finding at Aurobindo; substitute products without committee review.
